title: Introducing the Elevate Pay Card: Your Passport to Global Spending
summary: Meet the Elevate Pay Visa Signature virtual card. Top up from your USD balance, pay online or with Google Pay, and manage spending in the app.
body_markdown:
We built the Elevate Pay Card so you can do more with the dollars you earn. The payment from one project could cover the design software you need for the next, a certification you’ve been saving for, or a flight to meet a teammate you’ve only ever seen on screen.


The Elevate Pay Card is a virtual Visa Signature card you top up from your Elevate Pay USD account. You can use those dollars to pay online or in stores without first transferring them to your local bank.


## From your next project to your next trip


If you’re building a website for a client, you can use your card to buy the domain, pay for hosting, and renew the tools you use to keep it running. Just enter your card details at checkout wherever the merchant accepts Visa cards.


It comes in handy away from your desk, too. You can book a flight online, then use Google Pay to tap for coffee when you land. Tap to pay works on compatible devices in supported regions, wherever the terminal accepts Google Pay.


## Choose how much you want to spend


Your card has its own balance. Say a client pays you $500 and you want to put $50 toward this month’s subscriptions. Move $50 to your card, and the other $450 stays in your USD account.


Top-ups are instant and free. You can also move available funds back to your USD account instantly and for free. To check a payment or lock your card, open the **Card** tab in the app.


## Fees at a glance


-


**Getting your card.** Your first card costs $10. Annual renewal is $5. We waive either fee if you’ve sent more than $5,000 in local currency transfers in the 180 days before card creation or renewal.


-


**Making a purchase.** USD payments to US merchants are free. A 1.5% cross-border and cross-currency fee applies when you pay a non-US merchant in any currency or a US merchant in a currency other than USD.


-


**Repeated declines.** Starting December 1, 2026, only declines caused by a low card balance or a locked card count toward your monthly limit. Within each calendar month, we’ll email you on the third, charge $1.50 on the fifth, and permanently cancel the card on the eighth.


## Get your Elevate Pay Card


Update the Elevate Pay app and open the **Card** tab. If your account is eligible, tap **+** , review the fee, and confirm. Once your card is ready, top it up with what you need for your first purchase.
